programs.title: Shalimar
programs.desc: Kumar, a thief, aspires to be mafia boss Sir John's successor by stealing Shalimar, a priceless diamond. Adamant to succeed in his mission, Kumar must overcome many tribulations to seize the diamond.

programs.title: Hum Dono
programs.desc: Raja discovers that his face is similar to that of Dr Shekhar, one of the top earning doctors of Bombay. He manages to take his place, but discovers that Dr Shekhar has many problems of his own.

programs.title: Aitbaar
programs.desc: Trying to escape an abusive marriage with Jaideep, Neha returns to her ex-lover Sagar. However, when Jaideep claims that he is a changed man, Neha faces a dilemma about whom she wants to be with.

programs.title: Apna Bana Lo
programs.desc: A widowed mother loses her child near a well during a journey on foot. Follows her emotional path through grief and acceptance as she navigates life after the devastating loss.
